versions.content: Sequence of Build Actions The data involved in BuildAction s can be used to determine an appropriate execution order. The following hints apply: • Actions consuming data shall be performed after actions producing or modifying the same data. • An action consuming and producing the same data shall use modifiedData . Otherwise this action would be its own predecessor / successor. • modifiedData in particular supports the case that an action manipulates or verifies existing data. These action shall be performed before any consuming actions. • Implicit interdependencies between BuildAction s can be specified using pre- decessorAction respectively followUpAction .
